There are 7 implementing types. Note that `AbstractGatewayDeviceSessionContext` and `DefaultCoapClientContext$CoapSessionListener` / `DeviceApiController$HttpSessionListener` are inner/subclasses — their source files need to be verified:

- `DefaultCoapClientContext$CoapSessionListener` lives in `DefaultCoapClientContext.java`
- `DeviceApiController$HttpSessionListener` lives in `DeviceApiController.java`

common/transport/mqtt/src/main/java/org/thingsboard/server/transport/mqtt/session/AbstractGatewayDeviceSessionContext.java | implements SessionMsgListener (abstract base for gateway device sessions)
common/transport/coap/src/main/java/org/thingsboard/server/transport/coap/callback/AbstractSyncSessionCallback.java | implements SessionMsgListener (abstract sync CoAP session callback)
common/transport/coap/src/main/java/org/thingsboard/server/transport/coap/client/DefaultCoapClientContext.java | contains inner class CoapSessionListener implementing SessionMsgListener
common/transport/http/src/main/java/org/thingsboard/server/transport/http/DeviceApiController.java | contains inner class HttpSessionListener implementing SessionMsgListener
common/transport/snmp/src/main/java/org/thingsboard/server/transport/snmp/session/DeviceSessionContext.java | implements SessionMsgListener (SNMP device session context)
common/transport/lwm2m/src/main/java/org/thingsboard/server/transport/lwm2m/server/LwM2mSessionMsgListener.java | implements SessionMsgListener (LwM2M session listener)
